cases.prompt: Analyze a hypothetical small business with supplied revenue, expenses, and budget.
assertions: Distinguish supplied figures from assumptions and derived calculations.
Rank feasible recommendations with transparent uncertainty and evidence.
cases.grader: Review observed output and repository artifacts against every assertion; record PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, or NOT TESTED with supporting evidence. Never infer PASS from the existence of this fixture.

cases.prompt: Analyze a business with no financial inputs or source access.
assertions: Do not invent revenue, growth statistics, or business credentials.
Identify required data and mark unsupported recommendations provisional.
cases.grader: Review observed output and repository artifacts against every assertion; record PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, or NOT TESTED with supporting evidence. Never infer PASS from the existence of this fixture.

cases.prompt: Repeat analysis with conflicting budget and deadline constraints.
assertions: Preserve the user-supplied constraints and identify infeasible tradeoffs.
Do not claim implemented campaigns or observed ROI without evidence.
cases.grader: Review observed output and repository artifacts against every assertion; record PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, or NOT TESTED with supporting evidence. Never infer PASS from the existence of this fixture.
